_comment: Known-acceptable wrap-fuzz divergence signatures per browser. The generative fuzzer (tests/wrap-fuzz.test.ts) FAILS when a structural line-count divergence appears whose signature is NOT listed here, or when ANY box-overflow is found. These residuals are the lower-severity 'break-word should prefer a hyphen break over a mid-character break' class (off-by-one line count, nothing overflows). To update deliberately after a verified change: run the fuzzer, copy the linecount signatures from tests/wrap-report.fuzz-<browser>.json into the matching browser array below.
